sasha: Ran nightly perf-run against prod cluster, saw ~18% regression in token-level latency for /chat route when KV cache hit ratio dipped from 0.92 -> 0.61. Attaching quick flame/profile snippet.

matt: :( any idea trigger? recent deploys?

sasha: suspect kernel-selection fallback. profiler shows we moved from fused-attn kernel to fallback aten kernel around same time.

emma: can you paste the trace? want to see per-token breakdown (decode vs attention vs kernel select)

sasha: ```
PROFILING TRACE (sample)
model: redwood-chat-v1, seq=512, batch=1
token 1-100: kernel_select=1.2ms, attention_fused=6.8ms, kv_copy=0.4ms, decode=0.9ms
token 101-200: kernel_select=12.1ms, attention_aten=18.3ms, kv_copy=0.5ms, decode=1.1ms
kv_hit_ratio=0.61
``` 

raj: batcher change last week increased max_batch_time from 4ms -> 8ms; could push different kernel choices because sequence length distribution shifted. i'll diff the change now: https://git.redwood/internal/changes/PR-3421 :eyes:

jia: we should add token-level breakdown panels to Grafana: per-route p50/p90 token-latency, stacked breakdown by component (kernel_select|attention|kv_copy|decode), plus kv_cache_hit_ratio as a drilldown. Also need a derived metric `billing.tokens.billed` that's aligned to what billing pipeline counts (not raw model tokens) so cost_per_token = billing_cost / billing.tokens.billed

matt: i'll take dashboard + metrics. proposed metric names: `inference.token.latency_ms`, tag by {route,model,kernel_variant,kv_hit}, and `inference.token.latency_ms.by_component` with components as tag values. billing metric: `billing.tokens.billed` and `billing.cost.usd`

sasha: perfect. add an alert: if p90 token-latency increases >15% and kv_hit_ratio drops >10% for 10m, trigger incident. include automation to snapshot kernel config and last-deploy commit.

ops-bot: deploy event: prod/dc-west rollout v1.18.3 by matt at 2025-11-03T02:18:44Z :rocket:

emma: small note — make sure metrics library adds `batch_size` and `seq_len_bucket` tags so we can attribute cost to batching heuristics.

matt: will open a PR for metrics + grafana panels, link here when ready.

sasha: thanks — after dashboard up, let's run a sensitivity sweep (kv_hit ratios 0.3->0.95) to quantify cost impact. :thumbsup:
